definitions.explanation: Proceeding without problems or conflicts; operating efficiently and pleasantly.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{円滑|えんかつ}に{進|すす}んだ。
{円滑|えんかつ}な{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい}を{築|きず}く。
コミュニケーションを{円滑|えんかつ}にするために{定期的|ていきてき}に{話|はな}し{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: We have regular discussions to facilitate smooth communication.

notes:
{円滑|えんかつ} is a na-adjective meaning smooth, without friction or problems. Common in business, administrative, and formal contexts.

FORMS:
- {円滑|えんかつ}な + noun: smooth ~ ({円滑|えんかつ}な{運営|うんえい})
- {円滑|えんかつ}に + verb: smoothly ~ ({円滑|えんかつ}に{進|すす}む)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {円滑|えんかつ}に{進|すす}む: to proceed smoothly
- {円滑|えんかつ}な{運営|うんえい}: smooth operation
- {円滑|えんかつ}な{関係|かんけい}: harmonious relationship
- {円滑|えんかつ}なコミュニケーション: smooth communication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スムーズ: smooth (loanword, more casual, broader usage)
- {順調|じゅんちょう}: going well, favorable (focuses on progress toward a goal)
- {滑|なめ}らか: smooth (physical texture or graceful movement)
